# manifold Provider

Manage Manifold resources through the management API. Authenticates as an OIDC client (OAuth2 client credentials) created under **Settings → Access → Credentials** in the Manifold dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    manifold = {
      source = "manifold-security/manifold"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are usually supplied via MANIFOLD_CLIENT_ID / MANIFOLD_CLIENT_SECRET.
provider "manifold" {
  endpoint     = "https://acme.app.manifoldsecurity.io"
  organization = "org_abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_domain` (String) Host that issues access tokens. Defaults to `auth.manifoldsecurity.io`. Can also be set with `MANIFOLD_AUTH_DOMAIN`.
- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID. Can also be set with `MANIFOLD_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OIDC client secret. Can also be set with `MANIFOLD_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `endpoint` (String) Root URL of your Manifold instance, e.g. `https://acme.app.manifoldsecurity.io`. Can also be set with `MANIFOLD_ENDPOINT`.
- `organization` (String) Organization the token is scoped to, as shown with the client in the dashboard. Can also be set with `MANIFOLD_ORGANIZATION`.
